overview:
TX-30 is an open seat after redistricting drew a solidly Democratic Dallas-area district, with a partisan lean of about 25 points toward Democrats. Frederick Haynes III, the Democratic nominee, has raised over $420,000 and holds a large cash advantage, while Republican Everett Jackson has raised only about $17,000 with minimal cash on hand. Outside groups have also spent roughly $200,000 supporting Haynes.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 97%, and no expert raters list the race as competitive. With no general-election polling available, the forecast rests on the district's fundamentals, which point clearly to a Safe Democratic outcome.
